summary: Youlife Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a strategic cooperation agreement with Dazhou Technician College. The ten-year partnership covers enrollment, curriculum, training, internships, and employment placement to expand its vocational education network in Western China. No financial terms, share prices, or transaction structure are disclosed. The filing is a routine business update about an operational partnership, not a special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks. This is a standard current report on foreign private issuer operations.
